description: Permission set for artifact widget windows (the deck — PRD Part C / W2). Each `widget-*` window renders one pinned artifact and moves independently with native window dragging. The glob means any other label gets no IPC. These windows deliberately get a narrower set than system panels: they may move, resize, close themselves, connect to the same WS server, and hand external links to the system browser. `allow-open-widget` is granted for exactly one reason: vendor/moon-cmdk.js binds Cmd+K in EVERY shell, and without this grant the invoke is rejected and swallowed by its .catch() - the key would be silently eaten inside artifact windows. The Rust side still validates the kind against the registry and refuses non-system trust, so this does not widen what can actually be opened.
